notes.title: SENTIENT STEEL 1.1 Update Out Now!
notes.content:
A few months ago I decided to take a break from my new project, Morpho (working title), to return to SENTIENT STEEL with fresh eyes, over a year after release. 

As a thank you to those who have played, and as a personal bookend on this project, I wanted to publish a comprehensive free update to address the shortcomings that I ran out of time to fix last year.

Over time, the scope of the update expanded, until I had eventually looked at almost every element of the game. Here's a list of the key improvements:

Significantly improved performance

Gameplay improvements and rebalancing

Overhauled visuals and interfaces

Fixed audio

120fps support

Improvements for Steam Deck

Numerous bug fixes

So, whether you're back to fight the infection all over again, or returning to finish it off, I hope you enjoy the updates in 1.1!

Lastly, if you're new to SENTIENT STEEL, please consider trying the free demo! It has been updated to Ver. 3, which includes all the improvements present in the main game.

Thank you for all of your kind support.

- etcher

notes.title: SENTIENT STEEL Demo Ver. 2 is out now!
notes.content:
SENTIENT STEEL has changed a lot since the original Demo released. As the list of improvements grew, I realised you were all left with a largely outdated version of the Demo, so today I'm here to fix that!

Ver. 2 includes the first two Missions of the game: both of which have been almost completely overhauled, and include some brand new surprises. Unfortunately, as the structure of the game has solidified in the lead-up to release, I've had to remove the third Mission (don't worry, it's still in the final game!) I apologise for this, and hope that the two reworked Missions will suffice until February.

You'll also find improved visuals, improved UI, requested features such as adjustable music and SFX volume, and, of course, many, many bug fixes.

Thank you for your continued support. SENTIENT STEEL is coming soon!

- etcher

notes.title: SENTIENT STEEL Demo is available now!
notes.content:
A huge thank you to those who have already downloaded and played the SENTIENT STEEL Demo!

If you haven't had a chance to try it yet, you can look forward to:


 3 fast-paced Missions, playable in day or night mode
 Sliding, wall-running, and rail-grinding in and around Machine growths 
 Destroying powerful Machines with close- and long-range combat
 Full controller compatibility (but plays great with a keyboard!)
 All of the above playable solo or co-op

Thank you for all of your support so far, I'm going to get back to work to make the final game as good as it can be!

- etcher
